description: Angular component for configuring argument mappings in a rule node, including form controls, drag-and-drop reordering, validation, and dynamic form setup based on selected functions.

classes.name: ArgumentsMapConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing argument mapping configuration in a rule node.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form values from an external arguments list.

methods.name: removeArgument
methods.description: Removes an argument at a specified index.

methods.name: addArgument
methods.description: Adds a new argument control to the form.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form and returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: setupArgumentsFormGroup
methods.description: Configures the arguments form group based on the selected function.

methods.name: createArgumentControl
methods.description: Creates a new form group for an argument with validators and subscriptions.

methods.name: updateArgumentControlValidators
methods.description: Updates validators for argument control based on argument type.

methods.name: updateArgumentNames
methods.description: Synchronizes argument names with their index.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Propagates form value changes to external callback.
